summary: Use ECMAScript ignoreCase canonicalization rather than .NET RegexOptions.IgnoreCase.

target.notes: ECMAScript i matching uses specification-defined canonicalization whose behavior depends on Unicode mode; host-culture .NET case comparison is not equivalent.

caveats: Case-folding edge cases differ across engines/options; do not assume RegexOptions.IgnoreCase preserves JS.
